source_problem: Current G9 V3 cycle directly calls Needle.execute(effect_intent), but the exact current Frank target API requires a typed authority/lifecycle pipeline and execute(intent, capability, node, attempt). G9 V3 and target EffectIntent field shapes are also non-identical.
proposed_change: Implement a deterministic typed Needle boundary adapter/lowering between cognitive EffectIntent and the current Frank effect runtime. Do not change ClayCode language semantics unless that implementation path is later falsified by an executable counterexample.
required_adapter_obligations: Consume cognitive intent as proposal only.
Resolve exact action, target and payload from current typed semantic state; missing material data fails closed or degrades to proposal.
Obtain authenticated actor/current credential scope from trusted runtime context, never from model text or GWT salience.
Resolve opaque capability from current trusted capability state; no structural or textual capability forgery.
Construct the exact current EffectRequest and evaluate decide_effect/authorize_effect.
Create and persist an exact EffectReservationReceipt before any external attempt.
Create EffectAttempt bound to authorization, reservation, node, idempotency and current capability.
Invoke exact frank.effects.execute(intent, capability, node, attempt).
Independently verify outcome; preserve OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and reconciliation semantics.
Re-enter only verified/provenance-bound outcome state before DONE.
forbidden_shortcuts: No model-minted AUTHENTICATED_USER, capability, EffectAuthorization, reservation or EffectAttempt.
No conversion of API token presence into unlimited effect authority.
strongest_counterhypothesis: An existing exact current hidden adapter already performs these steps and the G9 V3 line is documentation shorthand only.
discriminating_test: Find or implement the exact typed adapter, bind it to current target source/component/binary/state/lease identities, then run positive and negative target-VPS tests covering actor/capability forgery, stale epochs, confirmation replay, reservation atomicity, idempotent retry vs reconciliation, execute arity/type mismatch, independent verification and provenance re-entry.
rollback: Keep current target frank.effects implementation and G9 V3 source unchanged until the adapter passes. Candidate artifacts can be deleted without runtime effect.
